Your summary should consist of two parts, modifications in each file and their relationships.

From fb092eb63d3aba5b876a51cbe743c1c8a8b37d5b Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Sebastian Andrzej Siewior <bigeasy@linutronix.de>
Date: Fri, 31 May 2019 22:30:09 -0700
Subject: [PATCH] arch/arm/boot/compressed/decompress.c: fix build error due to
 lz4 changes

  include/linux/cpumask.h: In function 'cpumask_parse':
  include/linux/cpumask.h:636:21: error: implicit declaration of function 'strchrnul'; did you mean 'strchr'? [-Werror=implicit-function-declaration]

Because arch/arm/boot/compressed/decompress.c does

#define _LINUX_STRING_H_

preventing linux/string.h from providing strchrnul.  It also #includes
asm/string.h, which for arm has a declaration of strchr(), explaining why
this didn't use to fail.

Link: http://lkml.kernel.org/r/20190528115346.f5a7kn3hdnuf5rts@linutronix.de
Fixes: 3713a4e1fdb8d ("include/linux/cpumask.h: fix double string traverse in cpumask_parse")
Suggested-by: Rasmus Villemoes <linux@rasmusvillemoes.dk>
Cc: Yury Norov <ynorov@marvell.com>
Cc: Thomas Gleixner <tglx@linutronix.de>
Cc: Russell King <rmk+kernel@arm.linux.org.uk>
Signed-off-by: Andrew Morton <akpm@linux-foundation.org>
Signed-off-by: Linus Torvalds <torvalds@linux-foundation.org>

diff --git a/arch/arm/boot/compressed/decompress.c b/arch/arm/boot/compressed/decompress.c
index c16c1829a5e4..aa075d8372ea 100644
--- a/arch/arm/boot/compressed/decompress.c
+++ b/arch/arm/boot/compressed/decompress.c
@@ -32,6 +32,7 @@
 extern char * strstr(const char * s1, const char *s2);
 extern size_t strlen(const char *s);
 extern int memcmp(const void *cs, const void *ct, size_t count);
+extern char * strchrnul(const char *, int);
 
 #ifdef CONFIG_KERNEL_GZIP
 #include "../../../../lib/decompress_inflate.c"
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `arch/arm/boot/compressed/decompress.c`**
   - Added the declaration of the function `strchrnul`:
     ```c
     extern char * strchrnul(const char *, int);
     ```

### Relationships Between Modifications

The modification in `decompress.c` addresses a build error that arose due to changes in the LZ4 compression code. The error was caused by the absence of the `strchrnul` function, which was not being included because of a macro definition (`_LINUX_STRING_H_`) that prevented the inclusion of `linux/string.h`. By explicitly declaring `strchrnul` in `decompress.c`, the patch resolves the implicit declaration error, ensuring that the function can be used without causing build failures. This change is directly related to the previous modifications in `include/linux/cpumask.h`, which aimed to fix a double string traverse issue in the `cpumask_parse` function.

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```c
#define _LINUX_STRING_H_
#include <asm/string.h>
```
Reason:
The definition of the macro `_LINUX_STRING_H_` prevents the inclusion of `linux/string.h`, which contains the declaration for the `strchrnul` function. As a result, when `strchrnul` is referenced in `include/linux/cpumask.h`, it leads to an implicit declaration error because the function is not recognized.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
+extern char * strchrnul(const char *, int);
```
Reason:
By adding the declaration for `strchrnul` in the code, the implicit declaration error is resolved. This allows the compiler to recognize the function when it is referenced, thus fixing the build error caused by the previous omission.
